crossRefs.note: Naaman, Ahijah, and Gera, who carried them captive; and he became the father of Uzza and Ahihud.

people.name: Ahihud
people.line: Son of Ehud, from the tribe of Benjamin

people.name: Ahijah
people.line: Son of Ehud, from the tribe of Benjamin

people.name: Naaman
people.line: A descendant of Benjamin, son of Ehud.

translations.web: Naaman, Ahijah, and Gera, who carried them captive; and he became the father of Uzza and Ahihud.
translations.bsb: Naaman, Ahijah, and Gera, who carried them into exile and who was the father of Uzza and Ahihud.
translations.kjv: And Naaman, and Ahiah, and Gera, he removed them, and begat Uzza, and Ahihud.
translations.asv: and Naaman, and Ahijah, and Gera, he carried them captive: and he begat Uzza and Ahihud.
